_readme: HAND-WRITTEN every iteration by Claude (or the agent doing the build): what Claude is LOOKING FOR this version. Only put questions here that ONLY the user can answer (real GPU frame rate, phone feel, 'does X look right'). Then run: node tools/build-claude-check.mjs --version <Vnnn> --categories "<names>" . kinds: text | yesno | choice (needs choices) | number. device: any | desktop | phone | touch | gpu.
summary: V194: SoundNode (202 sound settings), sound on any node, frequency-driven particles (63 settings, count), SoundViewer + SoundParticleViewer, Admin sound settings

asks.question: Press Play on a Sound node (Home > Create > Sound node, then Play in its settings). Do you hear a clean soft A4 tone, with no clicks, pops or distortion?
asks.why: Audio was only analysed in a headless browser with no speakers; nobody has heard it.

asks.question: Switch dynamic from pppp to ffff. Do the steps rise evenly and ffff is loud but not harsh?
asks.why: The dynamic marks map to gain by a table I chose; the loudness balance is unjudged.

asks.question: Try presets (pad, pluck, arp, heartbeat, swell). Which sound wrong or boring?
asks.why: 15 presets were tuned by numbers, not by ear.

asks.question: Turn positional on and fly around a node. Does it get louder when near and pan left/right?
asks.why: Spatial audio built but not heard.

asks.question: Do the particles look good and follow the sound? How many particles can you run before it lags?
asks.why: Particles were seen only on software GL (about 1 fps); real frame rate unknown. Cap is 4000 per node and 20000 total.

asks.question: 202 sound settings plus 63 particle settings: right amount, or should some hide under an Advanced fold?
asks.why: You asked for almost every setting; I want to know if the panel feels overwhelming.

asks.question: On a phone, does the first tap enable sound, and are the settings window and viewers usable?
asks.why: iOS/Android autoplay unlock and touch were never tested.

asks.question: Should the OmniMixer music follow the Sound master volume?
asks.why: Now the music keeps its own volume (decision pending).

asks.question: Do forward and backward word directions look like what you meant?
asks.why: Words are screen-space tooltips, so forward = grows toward you and backward = shrinks away (with a small lift). Real 3D motion along the camera axis would need a different word renderer.

asks.question: Does Reset HUD reset what you expected?
asks.why: It resets window sizes, re-docks OmniNotify and returns the compass; it does not touch the dock row, hands, or the CryptX keyboard. Tell me what else belongs.

asks.question: Does the horizontal and vertical orbit now feel continuous around your current target?
asks.why: Verified by unit tests and a slow software-GL run only; feel was not judged.

asks.question: After a vertical orbit that ends upside down, the view rolls upright on release. OK, or should it stay rolled?
asks.why: Staying rolled would need a mouse-orbit rewrite.

asks.question: Are U / V the right keys for the LH vertical orbit?
asks.why: X/Y/Z are StrictAlign, WASDEQ taken.

asks.question: Which buttons were 'Bind' and 'Pulse'?
asks.why: I found no button with those names; I lifted the LH/RH ammo-name chips and settings circles above the Realities row. If you meant something else, tell me where it is.

asks.question: Does StrictAlign now give you exact placement (axis checkmark, arrows, step field)?
asks.why: Alt+Arrow keys are unused (browser back/forward); Alt works on the buttons and wheel.

asks.question: Do RH words / tooltips stop when you delete the node? Should anchors be deleted with their node?
asks.why: Proven in jsdom; the browser check only confirmed the anchor record is removed.

asks.question: Do the CryptX keyboard keys work now, with arrows at the bottom and the grip on the left?
asks.why: Real finger touch unchecked.

asks.question: Does the terminal match your theme in the scene and in the DOM, and does Both mode work?
asks.why: On a phone a canvas panel cannot raise the keyboard; use the DOM panel.

asks.question: Does the Terminal button now toggle all TerminalShellTunnels together (like the hand tunnels)?
asks.why: In the slow browser run the meshes seemed to stay visible for 6 s after switching off (probably the hide animation at 1 fps).

asks.question: Is the TimeData ruler what you meant (baseline 00:00:00, 25 notches, time consumed, week / month / decade lines)?
asks.why: Marker motion and hour pulse were not seen live.

asks.question: Should nodes appear as marks on the TimeData ruler?
asks.why: The registry stores seconds since app start, not dates.

asks.question: Do the round option buttons around the pads read well and clear the pads?
asks.why: Judged only in software-GL screenshots; below about 842 px phone height the second-ring chips can touch.

asks.question: Is 'orbit up' (camera goes up) the direction you expect on RH ORB-U / Y?
asks.why: I assumed the camera moves up around the target.

asks.question: Is the chip + popover what you meant by bringing the OmniHand / ConsciousHand tool options out?
asks.why: Or did you want more circles directly around the pad? The phone has little room, so I used a menu.

asks.question: Does the OmniDock_Realities row look right above the Dock, with the compass at its left?
asks.why: Only seen in software-GL screenshots; the Inspector or other windows can cover it.

asks.question: On touch: tap once = tip, tap again = open panel. OK?

knownIssues: V192 was built as four parts merged; checked only in jsdom and software-GL Chromium. Nothing was judged on a real GPU, phone or touch device.
The full 360-degree vertical orbit loop was verified by unit tests only (1 fps in the browser).
RH words stopping on delete is proven in jsdom; Chromium only confirmed the anchor record is removed.
On a phone, in Both mode, the DOM terminal panel can sit partly behind the settings panel; OmniChat Terminal tab is still its own echo box.
TimeData ruler marker motion, hour pulse, DST and high-DPI sharpness not seen on real hardware.
The main.js block checks in two older nodev tests fail only because several V19x blocks now interleave (merge artifact).
V191 was built as four parts merged into one; checked only in jsdom and software-GL Chromium. Nothing was judged on a real GPU, phone or touch device.
Camera ascend/descend and RH pitch were verified in jsdom only (an open Inspector covered the left pad in the Chromium run).
Real GIF and video playback on a floor panel, and real IndexedDB media save/load, were not verified.
The Realities dock row can be covered by open windows and the MiniMap corners.
Phone heights under about 842 px: second-ring pad chips can touch.
Perspectives in the toolbar is a Planned notice only; no perspectives panel exists yet.
